verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents an API, alongside a guided Dashboard flow, to submit disputes and monitor them through to resolution, so programmatic filing and tracking is a first-party capability. The pack has only this single mention, and none of the story's specific sub-elements are evidenced. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, evidence submission details, provisional credit handling, dispute status webhooks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
